info.name: EMPREINTE Live
info.summary: EMPREINTE Live video meetings in Nextcloud: schedule them in Calendar, start them from a document in Files.
info.description:
Standalone app that brings EMPREINTE Live video meetings into Nextcloud, alongside the official Calendar and Files apps — without modifying them. Start a meeting from a document and present it to participants, or schedule meetings from the calendar.
- 📽️ **Present a document in a meeting** straight from Files: the "Present in a meeting" action on a PDF, PPTX or DOCX creates the meeting with the document already loaded in it, ready to present - 👥 **Participants suggested from the document's shares**, completed by searching Nextcloud users and contacts, or by typing any email address - 📁 **Documents panel beside the meeting**: browse the associated folder with previews, send more documents during the meeting, remove them - 🔗 **Share links** for one file or a whole folder — read-only or editable, password, expiration — including for participants without a Nextcloud account - 🛡️ **Nextcloud permissions apply everywhere**: a user with read-only access can neither present nor share, enforced by the server - 🔐 **Secure connection** to an EMPREINTE Live account using OAuth 2.0, with an explicit consent screen - 🎥 **Create, list, join, and delete video meetings** from the dedicated **EMPREINTE Live** app (its icon in the Nextcloud top app menu) - 📅 **Integration** with the official Nextcloud Calendar application - 🔄 **Automatic synchronization** when the linked calendar event is moved to trash, permanently deleted, or edited - ♻️ **Reconciliation** of the "EMPREINTE Live" calendar on login (back-fills missing meetings, hides meetings that belong to another account — never deletes anything on the EMPREINTE side) - 👥 **Participant autocomplete** (Nextcloud users and contacts) - 🔗 **Organizer-only** meeting link, reserved for the creator - 🛡️ **Server-side** token management (no sensitive tokens exposed to the browser); public OAuth client secured by PKCE — no client secret to manage - 🚀 **Native Nextcloud integration** using official OCP APIs and events
